# X: (batch, inputs); W: (inputs, hidden); v: (hidden,)
H = np.tanh(X @ W + b)
scores = H @ v + c
residual = (scores - y) / len(y)

grad_v = H.T @ residual + penalty * v
grad_c = residual.sum()
delta = residual[:, None] * v * (1 - H**2)
grad_W = X.T @ delta + penalty * W
grad_b = delta.sum(axis=0)
